versions.changelog:
- Cleaned old references from bundled README.md, LICENSE, and other files
- Updated npm badge, install commands, and all URLs to new repo
- Removed all remaining traces of old 'fast-html-mcp-server' package name

- Renamed from fast-html-mcp-server to OpenTalk2HTML-NotMD
- New npm package: @aimino/opentalk2html-notmd (v0.1.2)
- Full rebrand with new GitHub repo: Aimino-Tech/OpenTalk2HTML-NotMD
- Updated description, workflow docs, and architecture overview
- 18 tools, 22 components, 25+ templates
- License changed to GPL-3.0-only

- Initial release of fast-html-mcp (version 1.0.0)
- Enables rapid HTML generation, patching, compression, and consistency checking for AI-driven workflows
- Provides 15 tools, 22 components, and 25 templates optimized for sub-second operations
- Supports flexible workflows: full page rendering, targeted element updates by CSS selector, multi-mode HTML reading (including compressed/text for token budgets)
- Designed for integration with Claude Desktop, VS Code Copilot, and similar AI dev tools
